take_homes: Start with one agent. Split only for different access, different dialect or different stance.
Give the synthesizer a framework like Rumelt's kernel so it picks one diagnosis and doesn't average the views.
Handoffs are where work goes wrong. After a run, have the agent audit the seams and write the lessons into CLAUDE.md.
